about: The content schema of adventure plugins, API v1 to v3 (v2 adds the sites plugins: site_files and the sites_ types; v3 adds the sites plugins' counters, foes, tasks, talk panes, duels, card trades and the words listed in v3_words — a plugin that uses one declares api_version 3): one source of truth for the game's PluginSchema and tools/adventure_plugin.py. Kinds: int, number, bool, string, text (a key of text.json), card (a card name), hex (six hex digits), file (a path inside the plugin), picture (a picture key), enum, array, object, map, oneof, single (an object with exactly one key of its options), ref (a named type). Object fields carry required, default and doc.

placeholders.target: the name of where the current step leads (or the next target)
placeholders.title: the quest's title
placeholders.count: a count: matching deck cards, waiting cards, reward choices or cards collected
placeholders.required: the matching nonland cards the deck gate needs
placeholders.cards: a reward bundle's offered cards, comma separated
placeholders.price: a site action's price in gold, this time
placeholders.uses_left: how many more times a site action with prices can be done
placeholders.card: the card a site copied, gave, took, sold or bought
placeholders.dungeon: the name of the dungeon a site's action or pane is about
placeholders.amulets: the amulets the hero carries, all colors together
placeholders.life_bonus: the life the places have added to the hero's start in every duel (0 to 10)

world.json.doc: The region's generator recipe and its named objectives.

places.json.doc: The region's markers (its port and castle), their pictures, map sprites and panes, and the voyage's words.

quests.json.doc: Quests and their steps, completions, the finale, targets, status lines, tasks and the region's talk.

foes.json.doc: Named duel opponents and the roaming creatures' decks.

rewards.json.doc: The reward bundles a reward choice offers.

text.json.doc: Every sentence, title and button, by key.

sites.json.doc: A sites plugin's places: their pictures, map sprites, panes and services, its flags and the dungeons its places tell of.

text.json.doc: Every sentence, title and button, by key.

slot.doc: A site slot of the region's world (1-127).

terrain.doc: A land terrain code of ShandalarWorld.

name.doc: A proper name shown as it is written.

flag_name.doc: A flag declared in quests.json flags (an island) or sites.json flags (a sites plugin).

road.doc: The site stands on a road.

prefer.doc: The slot chosen when it matches; else the first match.

objective.doc: A named objective: the first site its rule matches (RegionObjectives.site), -1 when none.

generator.doc: v1 knows one generator: an island cut from the mainland generator's terrain.

layout_version.doc: Saved with the world; bump it when the layout changes.

offset.doc: Where the square starts on the 64-tile map.

dice_salt.doc: XORed into the source world's dice for the island's own.

spacing.doc: Least distance between the castle, port and towns.

castle.doc: The castle's aim: from + a draw under span, x then y.

port.doc: The port's aim, on the shore nearest it.

turns.doc: Quarter turns drawn for the town aims.

aim.doc: Offset from center before the turns.

first_rule.doc: Where the first village prefers to stand.

trade.doc: Trade categories dealt to the towns and places.

choices.doc: The source dungeon is from + a draw under choices.

music.doc: The region's world music, an OGG in the plugin.

width.doc: World pixels; its foot stands on the tile.

anchor.doc: The pennant's offset from the tile, in world pixels.

banner.doc: A pennant over the marker while the flag is set.

do.doc: sail: the voyage; leave: close; boss: the finale's duel; rewards: choose and collect reward cards.

when.doc: The first pane whose conditions hold is shown.

title.doc: Default: the marker's name (mainland_name on the mainland).

subtitle.doc: Default: region.subtitle, else the region's title.

pictures.doc: Picture keys (each beginning with the plugin id and _) to their files.

target.doc: giver, port, castle, {site: N} or {objective: name, else: giver|port|castle}.

stage.doc: The quest's stage is within min..max.

quests_done.doc: All quests, or at least N, are completed.

deck_share.doc: At least percent of the main deck's nonland cards are the required pack's (its trusted card list); at least one nonland; every card known.

on_region.doc: The hero is (true) or is not (false) on this region.

here.doc: The hero stands at the target.

rewards_owed.doc: A reward choice is (true) or is not (false) owed.

cards_pending.doc: Reward cards are (true) or are not (false) waiting.

reward_choice.doc: Owe one reward choice for this quest.

claim_cards.doc: Move waiting cards into the bag while it has room.

refresh_appearance.doc: Redraw the region's pennants from its progress.

do.doc: accept the petition at the giver; go to a target; duel the quest's foe at a target.

guidance.doc: The clue and pane line while this step is current.

task.doc: The task row's objective while this step is current.

line.doc: go: the pane line at a town target.

approach.doc: duel away from the giver: the button and line there that open the quest.

giver.doc: A town or place slot of world.json.

steps.doc: The stage saved is the number of steps done; the last step is a duel.

complete.doc: Effects on completion, or the name of a completions entry.

errands_off.doc: Town slots that offer no ordinary errands.

town.doc: A giver town's line and the button that replaces its wise man.

face.doc: A CreatureBook row whose face the foe wears.

foe.doc: The foe whose deck (and life) the creature takes.

min_tier.doc: Roaming creatures at least this tier (lairs untouched).

skip.doc: A creature keeps its own deck when (world seed x seed + slot x slot + row x row) mod every is 0; every 0 never skips.

salt.doc: Mixed into the dice that place the sites and their dungeons, so two plugins never stand on the same tiles by the same draw.

flags.doc: The plugin's own flags, all off at the start of a campaign.

pictures.doc: Picture keys (each beginning with the plugin id and _) to their files.

dungeons.doc: The dungeons a site's spawn_dungeon can raise, by key.

counters.doc: API 3. The plugin's own counters, each a whole number from 0 to 1000, all 0 at the start of a campaign.

foes.doc: API 3. The opponents a duel action names, by key: a fixed deck, life and face, never scaled to the hero.

tasks.doc: API 3. Rows for the Tasks pane, each with a place on the map to guide the hero to.

title.doc: The row's title, and the map target's name.

done.doc: The words once done_when holds. Default: text.

at.doc: Where the map guides the hero: place:<a place of this plugin> or dungeon:<a dungeon of this plugin> (once raised). A task at a place is shown only on a land the place stands on.

when.doc: The row is shown while these hold. used and used_up read the place named by at.

done_when.doc: The row is done (and no longer a map target) once these hold. Empty: never done.

name.doc: The place's name on the map and its pane's title.

where.doc: mainland: one on Shandalar's mainland; islands: one on each island plugin's island the campaign sails to.

gap.doc: Tiles it keeps from towns, castles, dungeons and other places.

when.doc: The first pane without an id whose conditions hold is shown. The last pane without an id has no when.

id.doc: API 3. A pane with an id is never chosen by itself: a talk action opens it by its to.

one_of.doc: API 3. One of these texts, in turn.

by.doc: day: the next one each day; uses: the next one each time an action of this place is done.

id.doc: The action's own name in its site: its uses are counted by it.

do.doc: effects: pay and apply the effects; copy_card: pay and copy one of the hero's cards they pick; leave: close. API 3: talk: open the pane named by to (after paying and applying effects, when it has any); duel: pay the stake and fight foe, then win or lose; buy_card, sell_card: trade one of cards for gold.

prices.doc: The gold each use costs, in turn; once all are used the action is gone. Empty: free, and never used up.

result.doc: The lines shown once the action is done; none: the place's pane again.

pick_title.doc: copy_card, buy_card, sell_card: the card list's title.

pick_line.doc: copy_card, buy_card, sell_card: the line under it.

needs.doc: API 3. What the action takes besides gold, each time; the button is refused, and nothing paid, while the hero lacks one. Not on leave, buy_card or sell_card.

to.doc: API 3. talk: the id of the pane of this place to open.

foe.doc: API 3. duel: a key of sites.json foes.

win.doc: API 3. duel: what a win brings.

lose.doc: API 3. duel: what a loss or a draw brings.

count.doc: API 3. duel: when a use is counted (and the next price of prices is reached): each time the duel is begun, or only when it is won. The price is paid each time either way.

cards.doc: API 3. buy_card, sell_card: each card and its price in gold. The game never sells a card for less, nor buys one for more, than the most a town pays for it.

stock.doc: API 3. buy_card, sell_card: how many of each card are traded in a campaign. Default: without end.

result.doc: The lines shown; none: the engine's own sentence.

card.doc: One copy of this card is handed over (one in no deck first; else it leaves its decks).

amulets.doc: Amulets of a color, or of any (taken from the color the hero has most of first).

gold_at_least.doc: The hero carries at least this much gold.

on_mainland.doc: The place stands on the mainland (true) or on an island (false).

used.doc: This site's action was done min..max times.

used_up.doc: This site's action has used all its prices.

dungeon.doc: The dungeon this plugin raised on this land: none yet, open (still holding cards) or cleared.

has_card.doc: API 3. The hero holds at least min copies of the card, in a deck or not.

amulets.doc: API 3. The hero carries at least min amulets of the color (any: all colors together).

hero_color.doc: API 3. The color the hero chose at the start.

owns_magic.doc: API 3. The hero owns this World Magic.

food_at_least.doc: API 3. The hero carries at least this much food.

gold_below.doc: API 3. The hero carries less gold than this.

day_at_least.doc: API 3. The journey's day is this or later.

wizards_defeated.doc: API 3. At least this many of the five wizards are beaten.

at_peace.doc: API 3. Arzakon is banished and the hero walks on (true), or not yet (false).

difficulty.doc: API 3. The campaign's difficulty, 0 (the easiest) to 3, is within min..max.

plugin_on.doc: API 3. The plugin of this id is part of the campaign and enabled; a plugin not installed is not.

counter.doc: API 3. The counter (declared in sites.json counters) is within min..max.

site_used.doc: API 3. The action of another place of this plugin was done min..max times.

gift_waiting.doc: API 3. A gift for the next duel (extra life, the first move or a card in play) already waits (true) or none does (false).

any.doc: API 3. At least one of these holds. No any inside an any.

life_bonus_below.doc: API 3. The life the places have added to the hero's start (life_bonus, 10 at most) is less than this.

town_linked.doc: API 3. The town or city nearest this place on this land has the hero's mana link.

spawn_dungeon.doc: Raise the named dungeon on this land, its place, creatures and rules known, unless it is open there already.

counter.doc: API 3. Add to a counter, or set it (one of add, set); it stays within 0..1000.

amulet.doc: API 3. Give (or take) amulets of a color; the hero never carries fewer than 0 or more than 99 of one. Giving needs prices or needs on its action.

give_card.doc: API 3. One copy of the card into the hero's bag. Refused before anything is paid when the bag is full or the campaign's card rules allow no more copies. Needs prices or needs on its action.

next_duel.doc: API 3. A gift for the hero's next duel, one of: life (extra life), first_move true, card (begins in play). Refused before anything is paid while a gift already waits.

roll.doc: API 3. One outcome by its weight, drawn on the plugin's own dice for this land, place, action and use (the same after a reload): its effects are applied and its result lines shown after the action's. One roll an action, none inside a roll or a duel's win or lose.

reveal_map.doc: API 3. The map uncovered within radius tiles of this place, or of dungeon:<a dungeon of this plugin> once it is raised.

world_magic.doc: API 3. The World Magic is the hero's, and its seller sells it no more. Refused before anything is paid when it is owned. Needs prices or needs on its action.

mana_link.doc: API 3. A mana link with the nearest town or city of this land that has none, is held by no wizard and is not besieged. Refused before anything is paid where the land has no mana links or no such town. Needs prices or needs on its action.

life_bonus.doc: API 3. This much more life at the start of every duel, for good; 10 at most from all places together. Refused before anything is paid at 10. Needs prices or needs on its action.

teleport.doc: API 3. The pane closes and the hero stands beside the nearest town or city, where the journey began, another place of this plugin (place:<id>) or a raised dungeon of it (dungeon:<key>) — on this land and landmass. Refused before anything is paid when there is no such target here. The last effect of an action that does effects; not in a roll or a duel.

rules.doc: no_color: no cards of its color; no_artifacts; no_instants: no instants or interrupts; life_carries: life losses carried over; life_adds: remaining life added to the next duel.

cards.doc: Its treasure: cards of the base game or of a required pack.

distance.doc: How far from the place it lies, in tiles.
